description: Exact Ledger Reconciler — Explains which charges, refunds and fees make up a Stripe, PayPal or bank payout, with an exact solver instead of a model: subset-sum over integer minor units (meet-in-the-middle, DP, branch-and-bound) across candidate fee schedules (percentage + fixed, tiers, caps), withholding, FX rates and rounding conventions (half-up, half-even, truncate; per line or on the total). Paste a Stripe balance or p

conventions.description: Restrict the conventions searched (default: all rounding modes x both scopes x both FX date policies).

crossCheck.description: Run two independent LLM translations and keep only rows both produced (default true).

defaultCurrency.description: Currency for text rows that state none.

feeSchedules.description: Candidate fee schedules; the solver reports which one reconciles each settlement. Omit for no fees.

fixedPerSettlement.description: Fixed fee deducted once per settlement, in the settlement currency (rounded to its minor unit).

fxMarkupPercent.description: Spread applied to FX conversions: effective rate = rate x (1 - markup/100).

items.description: First rule whose kinds (default charge, invoice) and currencies match an item sets its fee: percent (or tiers) of |amount| plus a fixed amount, clamped to min and max, signed like the item.

fixed.description: Fixed fee per item in the item's currency.

tierMode.description: marginal: each band charged at its own percent; threshold: the band containing the amount applies to all of it.

tiers.description: Percentage bands on |amount|; amounts above the last upTo use the last band's percent.

fxRates.description: Direct rates only (1 from = rate to). The latest rate dated on or before the reference date applies; an undated rate is the fallback.

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (a time suffix is ignored).

items.description: Ledger lines. Amounts are signed (refunds and disputes negative) strings in major units, e.g. "1234.56".

amount.description: Decimal string; locale formats (1.234,56, (12.00)) are accepted and parsed exactly.

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (a time suffix is ignored).

group.description: Lines sharing a group (an invoice) are settled together or not at all.

maxLagDays.description: An item may settle at most this many days after its date.

nearMissToleranceMinor.description: Largest residual searched when reporting the closest near-miss for an unmatched settlement.

settlements.description: Payouts or bank settlement totals to explain.

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (a time suffix is ignored).

feeScheduleIds.description: Restrict the fee schedules tried for this settlement (e.g. its processor).

itemIds.description: Restrict the candidate items for this settlement.

withholdingIds.description: Require one of these withholdings; omit to also try none.

text.description: Messy source text for collections not given structurally. A CSV with a header (Stripe balance or payout-reconciliation export, PayPal activity export, bank statement) is parsed by code with no model, and so are headerless lines with one amount each (date, id, amount, currency, and wording that names one kind, such as Payment or Refund); anything else goes to a fast-tier LLM that must quote every row verbatim.

amountColumn.description: CSV header to read amounts from, e.g. "net" for a Stripe or PayPal export whose payout is the sum of net amounts. Default: the first amount-like column (Amount, then Gross).

terms.description: Fee schedules, tax/withholding rates and FX rates in prose or tables.

toleranceMinor.description: Accepted |residual| per settlement in minor units (default 0 = exact).

name: reconcile-ledger
